cards.title: Book losses against the gains you've already booked
cards.what: This year you've booked ₹18,900 of taxable short-term gain. Selling these (oldest units first, only as many as it takes) cancels tax on that. A short-term loss cancels short- or long-term gains; a long-term loss only long-term. You can buy them back if you still want them.

cards.title: Book ₹3,665 of long-term gain tax-free
cards.what: Sell these and buy them back the same day. You hold the same thing at a higher cost, so this gain is never taxed; the room resets on 1 April and doesn't carry over.
